advisory_rules._comment: === UNCONDITIONAL stage-based advisories (always fire for this crop+stage) ===

advisory.recommendation: Monitor tomato fruit quality and watch for cracking
advisory.reason: Tomato at Fruit Development stage — weekly action required
advisory.explanation: At Fruit Development stage (week 6–10), check for blossom-end rot (black bottom), fruit cracking from irregular irrigation, and early signs of Late Blight. Harvest tomatoes that have reached full colour to reduce disease pressure on the plant.

advisory.recommendation: Apply preventive fungicide to tomato — monsoon humidity risk
advisory.reason: Humidity above 70% increases Late Blight and Septoria leaf spot risk
advisory.explanation: Monsoon humidity (>70%) sustained over tomato Fruit Development stage creates prime fungal conditions. Apply Mancozeb 75WP (2g/L) or Copper Oxychloride (3g/L) every 7–10 days as a preventive spray, especially targeting lower leaf undersides.

advisory.recommendation: Reduce tomato irrigation — rain probability above 60%
advisory.reason: High rain probability forecast (60%+) for next 2 days
advisory.explanation: With 60%+ rain probability, reduce your drip irrigation by 50% today. Excessive soil moisture during Fruit Development causes blossom-end rot and Phytophthora root rot.

advisory.recommendation: Apply nitrogen top-dressing to onion at vegetative stage
advisory.reason: Onion at Vegetative Growth stage (week 4–6) has peak N demand
advisory.explanation: Apply Urea @ 30kg/acre as top-dressing now. Split the dose — apply half immediately, half in 2 weeks. Ensure you water lightly before applying to prevent leaf burn. This stage determines final bulb size.

advisory.recommendation: Spray Mancozeb on onion to prevent Purple Blotch — monsoon risk
advisory.reason: Sustained humidity above 70% triggers Alternaria porri (Purple Blotch) on onion
advisory.explanation: Monsoon humidity (>70%) is ideal for Purple Blotch infection on onion leaves at Vegetative Growth stage. Apply Mancozeb 75WP (2g/L) + Iprodione (1g/L) as a protective spray. Inspect for small white spots with purple margins — if found, increase spray frequency to every 5 days.

advisory.recommendation: Skip onion irrigation today — rain forecast
advisory.reason: Rain probability above 60% in next 2 days
advisory.explanation: With significant rainfall expected, skip drip/sprinkler irrigation today. Excess moisture in onion plots at Vegetative Growth promotes collar rot and purple blotch. Check bund heights after rain to prevent waterlogging.

advisory.recommendation: Check wheat germination uniformity — thin or re-sow sparse patches
advisory.reason: Wheat at Germination stage (day 15–25) — stand establishment check
advisory.explanation: Walk your wheat plot and count seedlings per metre. Target: 25–30 seedlings/metre row. Sparse patches (<15 seedlings/m) should be re-sown within the next 5 days while still within the optimal sowing window. Mark gaps with flags for re-sowing tomorrow morning.

advisory.recommendation: Skip planned wheat irrigation — rain forecast for next 2 days
advisory.reason: 60%+ rain probability eliminates need for irrigation
advisory.explanation: Rain forecasted with 60%+ probability. Wheat at Germination stage only needs 60–70% field capacity. Skip your scheduled irrigation — waterlogged seedbeds cause damping-off and seed rot. Check drainage channels are clear before the rain.

advisory.recommendation: Postpone tomato irrigation — heavy rain expected
advisory.explanation: Over 20mm rainfall expected. Skip today's irrigation cycle and check furrows for drainage blockage.

advisory.recommendation: Postpone irrigation and pesticide spraying on wheat
advisory.explanation: Rain is expected in the next 24 hours. Postpone irrigation and chemical spraying to avoid runoff and poor pesticide uptake.

advisory.recommendation: Accelerate onion curing and move to dry shed
advisory.reason: Rain expected during bulb maturity/curing stage
advisory.explanation: Rain during curing will cause onion bulb rotting. Immediately cover harvested bulbs and transfer to a dry, ventilated shed.

advisory.recommendation: Clear all field drainage channels — heavy rain imminent
advisory.explanation: Clear blocked drainage paths, bunds, and furrows before heavy rain. Waterlogging for >6 hours damages roots and promotes fungal conditions. Move farm equipment to high ground.

advisory.recommendation: Protect all crops from extreme heat — mulch and early irrigation
advisory.explanation: Temperatures above 40°C cause severe heat stress. Apply straw mulch (5cm) around crop bases. Irrigate before 7 AM and after 6 PM only. Do not irrigate mid-day — water evaporates before reaching roots.

pest.warning: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) Risk — Tomato Fruit Development Stage
pest.reason: Sustained humidity > 75% with temperatures 18–32°C for 2+ days
pest.explanation: This is the prime Late Blight outbreak window for tomato at Fruit Development. Apply Mancozeb 75WP (2g/L) or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb immediately. Inspect lower leaf undersides for dark-green water-soaked lesions.

pest.warning: High Late Blight Outbreak Risk — Tomato Flowering
pest.reason: Prolonged high humidity (>80%) and moderate temperatures for 3 consecutive days
pest.explanation: Humidity has exceeded 80% for 3 consecutive days — optimal Late Blight conditions. Inspect lower leaves for black spots. Apply Mancozeb 75WP (2g/L) preventively now.

pest.warning: Whitefly and Thrips Risk — Tomato Vegetative Stage
pest.explanation: Hot humid weather (>80% RH, 25–38°C) for 2+ days creates ideal whitefly and thrips conditions. Apply imidacloprid 17.8 SL (0.5ml/L) if >5 insects/leaf.

pest.warning: Purple Blotch (Alternaria porri) Alert — Onion Vegetative Stage
pest.reason: Humidity > 78% and warm temperatures (20–32°C) for 2+ days
pest.explanation: Prime Purple Blotch outbreak conditions. Look for small white spots with purple-bordered centres on onion leaves. Apply Mancozeb 75WP (2g/L) + Iprodione 50WP (1g/L) spray immediately.

pest.warning: Stripe Rust Risk — Wheat Tillering Stage
pest.reason: Cool humid nights (10–20°C, >75% RH) for 2+ days
pest.explanation: Cool, humid nights favour stripe rust spore germination. Monitor for yellow dust stripes on leaves. Apply Propiconazole 25EC (1ml/L) preventively.

pest.warning: Damping-Off (Pythium spp.) Risk — Wheat Seedling Stage
pest.reason: High humidity (>82%) + warm temperatures during germination for 2+ days
pest.explanation: Damping-Off can kill wheat seedlings under waterlogged, humid conditions. Ensure field drainage. Apply Thiram 75WS seed treatment if re-sowing. Walk the field and check for collapsed seedlings at soil level.
